title: config Module
content_markdown: The _config_ module enables dynamic, runtime configuration of OpenSIPS parameters by loading them from persistent storage at startup and exposing them to the script level via the [$config(...)](#pv_config "1.4.1.�$config(name)") pseudo-variable.
overview: The _config_ module enables dynamic, runtime configuration of OpenSIPS parameters by loading them from persistent storage at startup and exposing them to the script level via the [$config(...)](#pv_config "1.4.1.�$config(name)") pseudo-variable.
how_it_works:
All configuration variables are stored in OpenSIPS' internal cache, allowing fast access during SIP processing to maintain high performance. The cache can be updated in three ways:

* _Script_ – Assigning a value to the [$config(...)](#pv_config "1.4.1.�$config(name)") pseudo-variable updates the in-memory cache, but this change is not persisted to the database.
    
* _MI Commands_ – Using [config:push](#mi_push "1.5.3.�config:push") or [config:push\_bulk](#mi_push_bulk "1.5.4.�config:push_bulk") updates one or more variables in the runtime cache. These updates are also not saved to the database.
    
* _Database_ – Manually modifying values in the database, then triggering the [config:reload](#mi_reload "1.5.1.�config:reload") command, will refresh the in-memory cache with updated values from the database.

exported_parameters.name: db_url
exported_parameters.description: Database URL used to load the initial configuration values, and flush them at runtime using the [config:flush](#mi_flush "1.5.5.�config:flush") MI command.

exported_parameters.name: table_name
exported_parameters.description: Name of the table where configuration entries are stored.

exported_parameters.name: name_column
exported_parameters.description: Name of the column storing configuration variable names.

exported_parameters.name: value_column
exported_parameters.description: Name of the column storing configuration variable values.

exported_parameters.name: description_column
exported_parameters.description: Name of the column storing variable descriptions.

exported_parameters.name: enable_restart_persistency
exported_parameters.description: Enables restart persistency. Check the [Restart Persistent Memory](#restart_persistent_memory "1.1.1.�Restart Persistent Memory") for more information.
exported_parameters.notes: The example code provided in the documentation uses the parameter name 'restart_persistent_memory' instead of 'enable_restart_persistency'.

exported_parameters.name: hash_size
exported_parameters.description: Size of the internal hash table used to store config variables. Must be a power of 2 number, otherwise its value will be rounded to the closest value of 2 smaller than the provided value.

exported_mi_functions.name: config:reload
exported_mi_functions.description:
Replaces obsolete MI command: _config_reload_.

Reloads all configuration variables from the database.

examples.description: reload configuration cache from the database

exported_mi_functions.name: config:list

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: If provided and different than 0, it returns an array containing the description of the values as well.

return_value.description: Returns an array containing the description of the values if the description parameter is provided.

exported_mi_functions.description:
Replaces obsolete MI command: _config_list_.

Lists all config variables currently loaded in cache, printing temporary values as well. If the optional _description_ parameter is provided and different than _0_, it returns an array containing the description of the values as well.

exported_mi_functions.name: config:push

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: the description of the variable; if missing the description is inheritted, or a null value is used if the variable is new.

exported_mi_functions.description:
Replaces obsolete MI command: _config_push_.

Temporarily pushes a single configuration variable.

exported_mi_functions.name: config:push_bulk

parameters.name: configs
parameters.description: a JSON array containing a set of variables to be pushed. Each variable should be described as a JSON object with the following keys: name (string), value (string or null), description (string, optional).

return_value.description: The command returns the number of values successfully pushed.

exported_mi_functions.description:
Replaces obsolete MI command: _config_push_bulk_.

Pushes multiple temporarily configuration variables in memory.

examples.description: push bulk temporarily values to the config cache

exported_mi_functions.name: config:flush

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: if present, flushes only a specific config variable in database, otherwise the entire cache.

return_value.description: The command returns the number of values successfully flushed.

exported_mi_functions.description:
Replaces obsolete MI command: _config_flush_.

Flushes the variables from the memory to the database.

examples.description: Flush config variables to the database

exported_pseudo_variables.name: $config(name)
exported_pseudo_variables.description: Returns the value of the given config variable by name. Can also be used for temporarily changing the value.

exported_pseudo_variables.name: $config.description(name)
exported_pseudo_variables.description: Returns the description of a config variable if available.
